# TU1.5 final-flare comparison fixtures

The locally generated JSON fixtures are not substitutes for original assets.
They retain full input/output banks and original instruction observations.

- `lens_draw_geometry_tu15_hardware.json`: 71 payload, orientation,
  primitive and CRC cases.
- `lens_draw_callback_tu15_hardware.json`: 45 complete original `2E9C0`
  callbacks with actual authored definitions and curve pages; texture readiness,
  camera and visibility are declared controls. Whole `3803B0` initializes the
  source coefficient bank.
- `lens_draw_setup_tu15_hardware.json`: 45 actual metadata-row texture headers
  and nine complete original pixel-program publications.

Authority, exact reports, admitted limits and the next production boundary:
[`SOURCE_MAP_LENS_DRAWS_TU15.md`](../../docs/SOURCE_MAP_LENS_DRAWS_TU15.md).
The JSON fixtures are generated by `oracle_lens_draw_geometry_tu15.py` and
`oracle_lens_quad_hardware_tu15.py`; preserved commands and pins are in
`analysis/map-world-features/lens-reflection-20261015/acceptance.json`.
